name: pplx-decider-flash-v1.2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes:
ADDED 2026-11-02 from the derivatives round (base-model query on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, the base of the catalog's pplx-decider-v1-2). A DECISION model (task=decision), not a text generator: state plus a schema of typed questions in, per-option probabilities out of one forward pass. The card's pipeline_tag is text-classification with custom code and a 255-way readout, not a full-vocabulary lm_head - the tag does not change the class.

WHAT IT IS: the ~1/7-size student of pplx-decider-v1.2 (27B), distilled on the teacher's training requests to match its full probability distributions, then model-souped (weight averaging over several runs). Same joint request format and the same text+image support as the teacher. config.json is the Qwen3.5-4B hybrid stack unchanged (32 layers, 8 full-attention at indices 3,7,...,31, 24 linear_attention), so architecture, context and KV figures here are inherited, not re-derived by the author.

PARAMS: HF safetensors total 4,539,265,536 BF16 = 4.539B, slightly below base Qwen3.5-4B (4.660B) because the readout replaces the lm_head. active_params_b is recorded as the base's 4.660 and is not meaningful for a single-pass readout. HARDWARE GATE: passes easily - 4.539 x 0.5 GiB = ~2.3 GiB at 4-bit.

EVIDENCE PROVENANCE AND HONESTY FLAGS (read before quoting a number): every row below is CARD-SOURCED and vendor_claim=true. (1) It is SELF-REPORTED - this checkpoint is on no board we can read: it is absent from the Decision Index 0.2.1 mirror at clef-evals (data/leaderboard.json, generated 2026-10-01, read 2026-11-02), which is the only board this run actually opened. (2) The card prints Decision Index 0.3, a DIFFERENT EDITION from the 0.2.1/0.4.1 numbers carried by every other decision record here; do not rank it against them directly. (3) NO base-model column is printed - the comparison columns are the 27B teacher (68.09 joint / 77.43 vision), which this model LOSES to on both. So the usual 'beats its base on the same test' test cannot be run from this card; what it publishes is retention of teacher quality at one seventh the size. (4) No eval harness, sampling config or row count is printed beyond the suite and mode names.

MODE MATTERS: unlike the 27B teacher, this model is more accurate with ONE question per request (60.05) than with all of a request's questions sharing one sequence (58.88). Reproducing the better number requires the one-question serving path.
